26.t: Working with data: which bulb is brighter?
q: Describe how brightness changes from 1 to 3 cells.
More cells, brighter bulb, and it rises faster each time (40, 150, 330).
Explain why the bulb was brighter with more cells.
More cells give a bigger voltage, which pushes a bigger current through the filament, so it transfers more energy as light (and heat).
The bulb is marked 4.5 V. Explain what happened with 4 cells and what this tells us about choosing a supply.
6 V is above its rating: too much current heated the filament until it melted, breaking the circuit. The supply voltage must match the rating of the component.
